faqs.question: Do You Offer Free Samples Before Purchase?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer complimentary samples so you can confidently choose the right finish, texture, and colour for your space.

faqs.question: Do You Install Outside Of Dubai?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We serve all GCC countries including UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman. Delivery and installation can be arranged across the region.

faqs.question: How Long Does Installation Take?
faqs.answer: Installation timelines depend on the product and project size. After our site measurement, we will provide a clear schedule before work begins.

faqs.question: Can You Help With Design And Selection?
faqs.answer: Our flooring consultants can help you compare materials, finishes and layouts to find a solution that suits your style, space and budget.

faqs.question: Is There A Warranty On Products And Installation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Product and installation warranties vary by collection, and our team will explain the coverage for your selected flooring before purchase.

faqs.question: Do You Work With Interior Designers And Contractors?
faqs.answer: Yes, we regularly partner with interior designers, contractors, developers and project teams across the UAE and GCC.

PremiumSolutionsSection.title: Premium Flooring Solutions Across UAE & GCC
paragraphs: Z&S Carpets & Flooring Is One Of The UAE's Most Trusted Flooring Specialists, Offering An Extensive Range Of Carpets, Artificial Grass, Vinyl Flooring, Engineered Wooden Flooring, Outdoor Decking And Decorative Rugs. With Over 15 Years Of Experience Serving Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, And Across The GCC, We Bring Premium-Quality Flooring To Residential Villas, Corporate Offices, Hotels, Retail Outlets And Outdoor Spaces.

Our Team Of Flooring Consultants, Project Managers And Installation Technicians Are Committed To Delivering A Seamless Experience — From Product Selection And Sample Delivery To Site Measurement, Installation And Aftercare. Whether You're Refurbishing A Single Room Or Outfitting An Entire Development, Z&S Has The Expertise, Range And Resources To Deliver Exceptional Results.

BannerSection.title: About Us
BannerSection.description: Delivering quality solutions with trust, innovation, and excellence.

intro.title: Transforming Ideas into Exceptional Flooring Solutions
intro.body: Z&S Carpets started as a small shop in 2010 and quickly expanded to offer customers easy access to their multiple stores in the UAE, providing them with a wide range of floorings, including our in-house brand for the entire market retail of the United Arab Emirates. We import high-quality products from countries such as India, Turkey, China, and Europe which follow strict international quality protocols. In addition to the wholesale and retail vertical, we have even started exporting our products to countries like Oman, Saudi Arabia, Africa, and the rest of the GCC. Thus, making us known all over the world!

quality.title: Driven by Quality & Trust
quality.body: Looking for a way to update your habitat? The flooring could be the best solution. Flooring is becoming increasingly popular for good reasons like it is versatile, long-lasting, and inexpensive! This adaptable material may be utilised in a variety of ways to create an appearance that is distinctive to your home, workspace, or anywhere. We have emerged as a homeowner-favourite firm since we entered the flooring market in 2010. We offer bespoke modern flooring designs that you prefer because of our modern quarries, advanced technology, and dependable craftsmen. We also offer a comprehensive range of flooring solutions with installation services in a variety of forms, sizes, finishes, and edges to meet your design and aesthetic requirements. Every product we sell is of high quality, long-lasting, and resistant to weather and misuse. You can be confident that the natural stone kind you select will age gracefully over time without requiring you to invest much time, effort, or money in its upkeep. We will look at some of the most creative flooring designs that will astound you. We have the appropriate solution for you whether you want to upgrade your kitchen, bathroom, or workspace. So do not put it off any longer; start browsing your ideas with us and get inspired, let’s transform ideas into flooring works.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: Our mission is to put the consumer first, and we endeavour to improve ourselves regularly. Nothing motivates us to keep inventing and researching new flooring technology more than the delight of our clients. Their needs and expectations have always been and will continue to be at the core of everything Z&S Carpets does.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: As one of the best flooring companies in Dubai we aim to be the global leader for all flooring related solutions. We strive to offer our clients the most spectacular products imaginable, utilizing cutting-edge technology and the most cost-effective solutions.
